name: Higher Education Special Scholarship Scheme (ST students in non-Government paid hostels) - Tamil Nadu
provider: Tribal Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu

rules.quote: the Government also provides a Higher Education Special Scholarship Scheme for students staying in non-Government paid hostels.
To qualify under this scheme, the annual income of the student's parent or guardian should not exceed Rs.2.50 lakh.

rules.value: Must stay in a non-Government paid hostel
rules.quote: The scholarship amount is directly credited to the student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account to cover hostel accommodation costs.

amount.text: Rs 7,500 pa (UG arts/science, polytechnic); Rs 8,000 pa (PG arts/science, professional)
amount.quote:
Undergraduate Arts & Science Courses and Polytechnic Courses
 Rs.7,500/-
